C-LOCAL-TRACK-ARTWORK.Summary: Bundle and incrementally update track photos, logos and layout images used by daily races; exclude profile photographs.

Goals.Goal: Discover real image URLs for all published track configurations, deduplicate contents and bundle a verified local package.
Render daily race cards and details from local track artwork first, with cached network fallback for future sources.
Correct source URL resolution after the DG-Edge redesign, preserving track/configuration identity.

Constraints.Constraint: Use existing Provider architecture and pinned FVM SDK, preserve existing edits and public TLS verification.
Only public track artwork; no profile/avatar images, gallery downloads or account changes.
Keep telemetry inference and live traced circuit geometry unchanged.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No race-data offline cache, general periodic refresh, redesign, commit or push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every packaged file has verified size/SHA-256; identical contents share a file and repeat updates skip unchanged files.
All discovered available track configurations have photo/logo/layout coverage or explicit missing-source diagnostics.
Native Mac and narrow phone show local track images under denied image HTTP, without disabling metadata access in the normal app.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: FVM targeted tests, analyzer, package integrity verification and native app checks.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Coverage/size report, no profile URLs, local-image tests, screenshots on Mac and narrow phone.
